snippet: Train ternary ({-1, 0, +1}) language models without full-precision master weights. The weights stay packed at 1.6 bits (5 trits per byte) for the whole of training. The optimizer state is low-rank, about one byte per weight in place of the 12-16 bytes of master weights plus…
title: GitHub - oguzeldereli/ttf-ternary: Two-timescale threshold flips (TTF): training and converting ternary {-1,0,1} LLMs without full-precision master weights. ~1 byte of optimizer state per weight; 23B trains on a 16 GB GPU, Qwen3.8-27B converted and recovered on one 24 GB card. · GitHub
